name: Short 3 - one_in_two
script: In 2007, almost every second smartphone sold on Earth was a Nokia. Across all phones, it was nearly four in ten. The company was worth roughly a hundred and fifty billion dollars. Six years later it sold its entire phone business to Microsoft for five point four billion euros. And here is the thing that gets missed. It was not one mistake. It was a culture that had stopped hearing bad news.
